Class SimulatorRepository

java.lang.Object
repositories.SimulatorRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SimulatorRepository extends Object implements Serializable
Repository class for managing simulator instances. Implements Serializable to support object persistence.

    • add

      public Simulator add(Simulator sim)
      Adds a new simulator to the repository or updates an existing one. If a simulator with the same map, scenario, and user exists, updates its year and budget.
      Parameters:
      sim - The simulator to add or update
      Returns:
      The added or updated simulator

    • findBy

      public Optional<Simulator> findBy(Map map, Scenario scenario, User user)
      Finds a simulator by its map, scenario, and user. Prints information about the search parameters.
      Parameters:
      map - The map to search for
      scenario - The scenario to search for
      user - The user to search for
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the found simulator, or empty if not found

    • update

      public void update(Map map, Scenario scenario, User user, int year, Budget b)
      Updates an existing simulator's year and budget.
      Parameters:
      map - The map of the simulator to update
      scenario - The scenario of the simulator to update
      user - The user of the simulator to update
      year - The new year to set
      b - The new budget to set

      public List<Simulator> getSimulations()

    • copyFrom

      public void copyFrom(SimulatorRepository simulator2)
      Copies all simulations from another repository. Clears the current repository and adds all simulations from the source repository.
      Parameters:
      simulator2 - The source repository to copy from
